objects: CREATE INDEX beliefs_owner_attribute ON beliefs (owner, attribute)

CREATE INDEX beliefs_owner_corrected ON beliefs (owner, owner_norm)
    WHERE owner_norm IS NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX beliefs_owner_norm ON beliefs (owner, norm)
CREATE INDEX beliefs_owner_status ON beliefs (owner, status)
CREATE INDEX beliefs_owner_subject ON beliefs (owner, subject_id)

CREATE TABLE beliefs (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    owner TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    subject TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    about TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'other' CHECK (about IN ('owner', 'person', 'other')),
    text TEXT NOT NULL,
    norm TEXT NOT NULL,
    category TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'fact'
        CHECK (category IN ('fact', 'preference', 'contact')),
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'tentative'
        CHECK (status IN ('tentative', 'confirmed', 'stale', 'rejected')),
    confirmed_by TEXT CHECK (confirmed_by IN ('source', 'owner', 'rule')),
    first_seen TEXT,
    last_seen TEXT,
    valid_until TEXT,
    memory_id TEXT,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    owner_text TEXT,
    owner_norm TEXT,
    note TEXT,
    subject_id INTEGER,
    attribute TEXT,
    value TEXT,
    valid_from TEXT,
    structured_at TEXT
, erased_at TEXT)

CREATE TABLE "events" (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, belief_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES beliefs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, at TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('added', 'evidence', 'confirmed', 'stale', 'rejected', 'corrected', 'restored', 'retired_upstream', 'unconfirmed', 'merged', 'erased', 'moved')), detail TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '')

CREATE TABLE evidence (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    belief_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES beliefs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    owner TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    source TEXT NOT NULL,
    source_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    subject TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    about TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'other',
    category TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'fact',
    text TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    link TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    seen_first TEXT,
    seen_last TEXT,
    times INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    days INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    source_confirmed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    payload TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE (belief_id, source, source_id),
    UNIQUE (owner, source, source_id)
)

CREATE TABLE subject_sources (
    subject_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES subjects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    owner TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    source TEXT NOT NULL,
    source_person_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE (source, source_person_id, owner)
)

CREATE TABLE subjects (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    owner TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    key TEXT NOT NULL,
    display TEXT NOT NULL,
    kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'thing'
        CHECK (kind IN ('person', 'project', 'thing', 'owner')),
    kind_by TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'auto' CHECK (kind_by IN ('auto', 'owner')),
    contact_id TEXT,
    aliases TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    note TEXT,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE (owner, key)
)
